batting.name: KL Rahul

batting.name: MP Stoinis
batting.dismissal: c I Sharma b Kuldeep Yadav

batting.name: DJ Hooda
batting.dismissal: c DA Warner b I Sharma

batting.name: KH Pandya
batting.dismissal: c RR Pant b Mukesh Kumar

batting.name: PP Shaw
batting.dismissal: c N Pooran b Ravi Bishnoi

batting.name: RR Pant
batting.dismissal: st KL Rahul b Ravi Bishnoi

balls.text: short ball, and wide of off. Swatted back to Ishant's left to finish with a dot

dropped by Warner! But he prevents a six for DC. It was a full toss from Ishant, which was dipping to finish just outside off. Arshad swiped at it, as Warner at long-on leaps to get the ball in his hands, and drops it back sensing that he was falling back
Arshad is having fun too! He falls on his back knee, and still heaves this length ball angling across which finishes outside off. Four to deep point
short of a length just outside off at 115kph only, and pulled to deep midwicket. This time Badoni can't make the second
he sees Badoni hinting to get across, and bowls quite full and wide of off. Left alone, and wide called
change of pace, and on a length wide of off again. He swipes, but mis-hits it to long-on. They don't take the single
sliced to deep extra cover! He gets across the stumps, and opens the face of the bat to go aerially over extra cover, with the ball being fullish and wide of off
a low full toss angling across to end just outside off, and swung to deep midwicket. That is also Badoni's fifty

looks to scoop again, as he gets across the stumps. Mukesh bowls on a short of a length on the stumps, and the ball comes off Badoni's gloves while dribbling to Pant, who throws at the striker's hand, only to give away an overthrow. There's a break in play, as the physio attends to Badoni's hand
ohh, well bowled! Again Badoni is across his tumps early, and now tries to scoop this. But the ball is a yorker on fifth stump, and the ball takes the outside edge towards Mukesh
bowls a yorker-length ball angling across on middle and off, and is jammed halfway towards long-on. Badoni bags two again to keep frustrating DC

swept away to deep backward square! He gets across the stumps, and almost loses his balance, even as the ball races away to the fence. Mukesh bowled full and a bit wide of off, but Badoni was ready to rattle Mukesh again
cleanly hit, and he holds the pose too! Mid-off is inside the circle, and Mukesh goes full around fifth stump. Badoni opens the face of the bat, and lofts that over extra cover

dropped by Shaw! He was at square leg, and ended up a good few steps outside the circle in the end. Arshad went for the lofted shot off this full delivery on the stumps, and the ball went ballooning up off the inside half of the bat. The ball arrived to Shaw's left, and he spilled the chance

Khaleel is into a celebreappeal... and to turn his face pale, it isn't given out. DC are out of reviews, too. A yorker swinging in, and hitting Arshad's back leg, but outside leg. The ball dribbled away towards square leg to allow leg byes
on the shorter side, and in the channel outside off. Arshad went flashing, but was beaten by the bounce
wow, useful runs for LSG! On the shorter side of a length around sixth stump, and swatted wide of mid-off even as he played aerially
another short ball round off, and this is tennis-batted to deep square leg
superb shot! That looked so confident and commanding from Badoni. On a short of a length around off, and Badoni hangs back to pull over deep midwicket
on a length, and goes on with the arm to end around sixth stump. He goes slashing, but is beaten
this is slower, and fuller on off. Tucked towards cover to keep ticking
quicker, and flatter on a length on off. Clipped to deep backward square, as Badoni keeps bagging them along
ohh, just over extra cover! Again Badoni chose to jump out of the crease, and went inside out at this length ball angling into the stumps
short in length, and angling across from around the wicket to finish well outside off. Swatted down to long-off
skips down, and pushes at this length ball on off to long-off
shorter side of a length on off, and turning away. Punched to long-on after getting across, as he retains strike
full and on off, as this hints to turn back in. Pushed towards deep midwicket, and again Badoni rushes back for two
fuller side of a length, and wide of off. This straightens, as Badoni looks to cut but is beaten
this hints to turn away off a length, and finish around sixth stump. Pushed to point
on a length on middle and leg, and there's good bounce for Kuldeep. Nudged towards square leg, and Badoni pinches two
ahh, well played. A late clip off this fullish ball shaping into his pads for a single towards short fine
fullish and just outside leg. He went flicking but missed, and is called wide
Warner at point dives to his right at point, and gets a hand to derail the ball. It trickles towards deep point, though, as Badoni hacked at this slower ball, which was on a length, and wide of off
full and very wide of off. Left alone by Badoni
a length ball in the channel, which straightens away. He pushes at it, and gets an outside edge rolling to deep third
very full - nearly a yorker - just outside off, and driven to deep point
just over a leaping point! Short and wide outside off from Mukesh, as Badoni is nearly beaten by the extra bounce, with him hacking hard to deep backward point

off the glove, presumably, and four! Short of a length from Mukesh, as he pitches this on off and gets it to angle into middle. Badoni went to pull, but got a top edge - and not a glove - to beat Pant
goes fullish on off, and is clipped off the inside half of the bat towards fine leg
shorter side of a length on off, and turning away. Punched towards cover-point
slow, and dipping on a full length around fifth stump. Heaved across the line, and wide of long-on from the inside half of the bat
this turns away off a fullish length just outside off, and is punched to extra cover. There's a misfield by Stubbs, and they get two
this is much fuller and outside off, and slower too. Defended back
shorter side just outside off, and punched back towards Kuldeep
bowls short and wide of off, as Badoni slaps that hard to deep point

this is gone! There is a little sound as the ball goes into the keeper's gloves, and the finger goes up too. Mukesh banged this on a short of a length around sixth stump, while angling it in. The ball shaped back in, and cramped Pandya for room. He leapt a little to ride the bounce, but the ball ended up tickling his glove before going Pant's way
that made a lovely sound off the bat, as Badoni pulled at this short ball in the channel outside off. Single towards deep midwicket
bowls a dipping yorker on fifth stump, which Pandya jams to a straightish deep third
slower ball, and on the fuller side of a length on sixth stump. Guided to deep third

Mukesh goes "How's that?" for at least half a dozen times for a potential caught-behind chance, but it is not given. This time the umpire confirms whether Pant indeed reviewed, and the captain says he did. It was another sharp short ball on middle, which climbed up and shaped back in to finish towards leg. Badoni went pulling, as the third umpire waits for the UltraEdge. The ball went off his right wrist, with the ball ending down the leg easily. So DC lose all their reviews
on a short of a length on middle and off, almost cramping him, as Pandya nudges it down towards square leg, with his bottom hand off
Ishant welcomes him with a short ball on middle and leg, which he hooks to fine leg with his front leg in the air

taken at where an imaginary short point would have been! Warner signals that the ball seemed to curve away while in the air. Hood played the no-look pull off a ball which was not at all on a short of a length - it seemed to be on a good length, rather - with the line being around fifth stump. But Hooda, LSG's Impact Sub, seemed to have played early, and got a top edge to send the ball high up for a simple catch
another shortish ball just outside off, and punched to long-on
sees the batter hinting to walk down, and bowls a short ball wide of off. Left alone, and called wide
swipes at this length ball in the channel outside off, and gets a single to long-on
taps at this ball, which is around sixth stump, and on the shorter side. Single to deep third
short of a length just outside off, and punched towards cover
skips down, and looks to clip, but is hit on his front pad, as the ball is on a length on middle and off, and is angling in
on a length on off, and much faster at 101kph. Pushed to long-on
full ball angled into off, and defended off the inside edge. The ball rolls away towards square leg
flatter and quicker on the stumps, as the ball is full. Driven to long-on
backs away, and pushes aerially to cover's left, as the ball is fullish and on the stumps
full and flat at 95kph on middle and off. Turned towards square leg
fullish length, and drifting away towards off. Nudged towards cover
Hooda tries the sweep again, and gets a bottom edge off this full ball just outside off. The ball runs away to fine leg
ahh, this hints to turn away late and slow. On a full length on middle, and Badoni pushes towards cover to get off the mark

now Pant goes up for a caught-behind chance, but it is turned down. And DC review despite having only one review in hand. Rahul went to slash at this length ball which was turning away after pitching wide of off, and UltraEdge does confirm a faint little nick off the bottom of the bat. So Kuldeep also has Rahul in his pocket. LSG in a hole at the moment.
paddle sweeps this full ball around fifth stump to deep square leg
full ball dipping on middle and leg, and pushed towards cover
he stands on leg, and drives at this full ball on middle and off to deep point
much slower, and full on off. Tucked to cover to keep ticking
good bounce off a fullish length on off, and cut away to point
this is slow, and much fuller on middle and off. He goes deep in the crease, and nudges wide of long-on for two
slashed to deep backward point! Rahul is firing along nicely from one end. On a short of a length, and angling into off, as he plays late to beat point to his left
full and angled into off at 92kph. Driven to long-off again

now there is a confident appeal for lbw, but not given. Kuldeep has a word with Pant, who asks his bowler to calm down. A voice from behind says the ball hit Rahul's glove. On a full length on leg, and hinting to turn in, as Rahul went to sweep but was beaten by the slowness of the ball
ahh, Kuldeep bowls a bit too full, getting it to dip just outside off. Driven to long-off

bowled him! The man in form falls first ball. Pooran walks back a clueless man, as his off stump is flattened. Kuldeep is on a hat-trick. LSG losing their way after the powerplay, with Kuldeep taking the initiative for DC. This full ball dipped on off stump, with Pooran perhaps playing for the turn away, as he pushed at it outside off. But the ball sneaked through, and left him in a sour mood

spooned to backward point! Simple catch for Ishant in front of his chest. Stoinis went hoicking across the line, and ended up getting the leading edge. Kuldeep strikes in his first over back. He tossed this up for Stoinis, and went on a full length around off. Stoinis went swiping, but the ball was slow, and it dipped, before chipping up in the air
quicker and flatter, and fullish on middle. Turns in a bit, and is clipped to deep midwicket
full and wide of off while drifting away. Dragged from far away to drive to long-off
this skids through low off a full length on middle, and hits Stoinis' front leg outside leg, as he is beaten by the lack of bounce. The ball dribbles away to the off side for a leg bye
lofted over the umpire's head! He jumps out, and chips at this length ball angled into middle and off. The bat face slightly closed there
swipes this aerially towards long-on, with the ball being full on off
now bowls quicker, and full on off. Driven off he inside half of the bat to long-on
angled in, and slower. Goes full just outside off, and is pushed back to the bowler
bowls full and a bit wide of off. Driven to cover
another short-of-a-length ball from Mukesh, and this is on off. It angles in, and is nudged towards square leg
opens the bat face last moment to dab this length ball angling in and ending on middle and off. Single towards point
pushed towards extra cover, as he drives at this length ball angling into off
short of a length again from Mukesh, and he pitches around sixth stump. But it angles in towards middle, and is swatted back towards the bowler
driven wide of mid-of! Skips down a bit, and presents the full face of the bat at this short-of-a-length ball around sixth stump. Great timing
clipped between the keeper and short fine! A short delivery on middle and off, which angles in and finishes on leg. Rahul waits before nudging it off his hip to bag four
well fielded by the man at slip! He goes low and across to his right to save a few runs, as Stoinis drove at this length ball angling across, but got the toe-end of the bat
full ball shaping in towards middle and leg, and clipped wide of mid-on
driven down between the non-striker and the stumps. Presents the full face of the bat to push forward at this length ball angling into the stumps, and gets four more

dropped by Khaleel! It came low and in front of his left knee, and the ball rammed him back on his knee. It was bowled on a fullish length and angled across, as Stoinis pushed back aerially, and the ball rolled back to the off side

another loud and animated appeal for lbw by Khaleel... and the umpire gives it out after probably ten seconds. Padikkal walks back after a word with Rahul, as his low scores continue. He was hit on the side of his front knee, with the ball on the shorter side of a length just outside off. It shaped back in rather hurriedly to smack Padikkal past the inside edge, with his bat around off. Looked like umpire's call on first replay, but we'll see
on the shorter side of a length on middle and off, and shapes back in to hit his back leg as he looks to push forward
uff, this takes off from the pitch at 138kph! Khaleel bangs it hard and short around off, and Padikkal sways out of the way. Wide called
short again, and a bit wide outside off. Hacked to deep backward point for two more
hammered to deep point! Too short and very wide from Ishant, as Rahul reaches out and plays it from a nearly eighth-stump line. Four more for LSG
short of a length, and pushed to backward point

another wide. This is angled in from around the wicket, and lands on the shorter side on middle and leg. Padikkal looked to clip but was beaten. And we realise late that DC reviewed the wide call, although it stays. There's a long, long chat between Pant and umpire Barde, with Pant indicating that he perhaps didn't review it, although DC lose the review. Replays show Pant did make the T sign for review, although he wasn't looking at the umpire then
another one on a short of a length, and this is on middle and off. He is deep in the crease, and clips to square leg's left to get off the mark
good tight line and length. On a short of a length on middle and off, as Padikkal is nearly cramped for room while dabbing it down after opening his stance up
he shapes to get across, and ends on middle, with Ishant bowling fullish and outside leg. Padikkal went clipping but missed, and it's called wide
hacked to deep backward point, as Ishant bowls short and wide of off. Rahul uses his bottom hand to dispatch that
a low, dipping full toss on off, and driven to mid-off with the full face of the bat

Khaleel looks very confident while appealing for lbw, and it is given! De Kock has a chat with Rahul, and reviews. He went swiping across the line at this fullish ball, but seemed to have missed it entirely. Yup, there's no inside edge. It was on the fuller side of a length on middle and off, and angling in to show umpire's call on clipping the side of leg stump! De Kock is gone, but LSG retain the review
rams into the stumps at the bowler's end! It was bowled full, and on middle and off, as Khaleel angled it in and de Kock smashed that back
goes inside out again! De Kock opens the face of the bat at this full delivery just outside off - the line was just wide enough for him to free his arms - as he went wide of mid-off
this is a length ball on middle, which hints to straighten back in. Nudged towards cover for a hurried single

flayed away over cover! That is hit hard and flat! Khaleel angled one across the right-hander, going full and getting it to finish outside off. Rahul attacked with a fairly horizontal bat, and sent it flying off the bat
lofted over extra cover! Just on the bounce. Ishant went full and outside off, and de Kock was deep in the crease. He collapsed his back knee and went lofting with the full face of the bat
fuller side of a length just outside off, as Rahul drives to mid-off's right for another single
backs away, and Ishant follows. He goes on a short of a length at the stumps, and de Kock can only swipe towards midwicket for a quick single
on the bounce to point, as he hacks at this shortish ball in the corridor outside off
again Ishant bowls on the shorter side just outside off, although this isn't short enough for de Kock to attempt and time his pull. He is beaten eventually
short of a length around fifth stump, as Rahul hints to walk down before guiding it to deep third

ohh, now it's an inside edge for four! More good luck for de Kock, and more misfortune for Khaleel. The latter went on a length around fifth stump, with the ball going on straight after pitching. De Kock went driving, and the ball just went past the leg stump
another full ball which hits de Kock on the pad, as this goes on with the angle to hit his front pad outside leg, as de Kock looked to clip but missed
fullish delivery around off, and placed in the gap between point and cover

half an appeal for lbw, but that seemed heading down the leg side. Khaleel went full while angling this in, and pitching it on middle. It angled back in, and de Kock also got an inside edge as he looked to push forward
now Khaleel goes much fuller on a yorker-length ball in the channel outside off. De Kock looks to squeeze it out, but is beaten, with the ball swinging away
ahh, nearly slashed to gully! On the shorter side of a length from Khaleel, who went on a sixth-stump line, as de Kock went hacking away from his body. But the top edge went over gully

that has been clobbered over deep midwicket! Capitals record their second win. This was short but it sat up for Stubbs as he sat back deep inside the crease and muscled it away deep into the stands.  This is LSG's first IPL defeat while defending a score of 160 or more.
slower ball on a length outside off, defended back down the pitch. Hope was looking to whip it through midwicket
punched down to long-on
short ball into the body, helps this pull along to fine leg
chipped to mid-off, a direct hit from Hooda at the bowler's end splays the stumps but Hope was comfortably in.
punched on the up into the gap at sweeper cover
driven straight to cover
revere-swept in front of square, Pooran comes around from sweeper cover to cut that off
punched down to long-off as they jog the single
punched to sweeper cover
punched back past the bowler to long-on
works this in-drifter down to long-leg, aggressive running and he makes the second comfortably
driven down to long-off
goes back and across to defend this skiddy delivery, somehow manages to get some bat on it.
gets well forward and blocks
sumptuous from Hope! Lunges forward to get to the pitch of the ball and ends up creaming it through the covers as he makes contact.
is there a twist? Pant can't get hold of this googly as he steps out to swing clean, misses it altogether and loses his bat in the process. Rahul effects the simplest of stumpings.
flayed away to deep point
pushed back to the bowler
typically Pant! Dug in short on leg stump, Pant gets inside the line, swivels around and helps him over the keeper's head for four.
dabs it down to third man to get off the mark

that's the end of that! Frazer-McGurk slices this over the infield, but there's deep point in place just for this. His spell-binding knock is over. He began with a bang, overcame pockets of struggle to gallop past a half-century and has put Capitals within touching distance of their second win.
holds his shape and muscles this over cover, down towards the boundary rider
pulled to deep backward square leg
hammered down to long-off
slower ball but slips it down leg, Pant looks to tickle it fine but the ball flicks the pad on the way to Rahul
that was headed just one way the moment he hit it! Walloped over deep midwicket. Stand-and-deliver. Made it look so easy. Incredible power. So what if that boundary is big?
gets across the stumps to get closer to this slower and fuller delivery, drilled to long-off
scythes the cut to deep point
uses the pace and help this into the gap at deep backward square leg,  half-century on debut for Jake Frazer-McGurk
sliced behind point, the ball spins away and dribbles to beat short third man to the fence. Saw width on this slower ball and went hard. It's a game without half-measures
flat-bats this attempted bouncer, Krunal deflects it off his boot to midwicket, they take a single.
beaten as he tries to carve it behind point
looks to swing towards the leg side, gets an inside edge back to the bowler.
bowls a 115kph bouncer, well taken by Rahul.
three in a row now! Stays leg side of the ball and swings through cleanly to muscle it over long-off. This is stunning.
down on one knee as he swings through the line to hit inside-out over long-off!  Special stroke. This one's towards the longer pocket. 75-metre hit. Incredible stuff. Who said this boy only slogs?
clubbed over deep midwicket!  Mind you that's the shorter leg-side boundary and Krunal feeds him length on middle and leg. Tremendous bat-swing.
anticipates the batter giving him the charge and fires it way too wide, left alone

gets inside the line, is off balance or so you think, but how Pant still manages to get it up and over the infield at short fine is something only he can tell you. He does it so well, contorts himself into weird positions to give you the impression he's lost shape but that is trademark Pant.
looks to ramp this bumper over the cordon, beaten
audacious, outrageous, magnificent! Brings out the reverse scoop at the very last moment, after Stoinis released the full delivery. What hands. Unbelievable
slower ball into the pitch, mistimes the pull to deep midwicket. Got it high on the bat.
thumped straight to Bishnoi at the edge of the ring at cover, but he's put it down. Sitter.
mistimes a heave to deep midwicket. Stoinis went off-cutter first up
cut away to deep point
gives him the charge but is nearly foxed as Bishnoi shortens his length and spears it wide, Pant still manages to manufacture something as he uses the width to slap that to beat wide long-off.
steps out, gets to the pitch of the ball and boom! Into the sightscreen. Muscled.
swung away down to long-on
stays leg side of the ball and uses the width to slap this over the infield to sweeper cover
leading edge, just manages to chip it over Bishnoi. Wrong'un that he hit high on the bat in trying to work it to midwicket
swing and a miss once again from JFM
hustles a length ball on middle, Pant tucks it wide of midwicket
squeezed to long-on
picks the slower one as he makes room to loft over cover but is beaten
right into the blockhole, Fraser-McGurk looks to tickle it fine but is late on it as the ball hits him flush on the boot.
slower and fuller outside off, driven straight to cover
beaten as he tries to reverse sweep Bishnoi, hit on the pad but impact was outside off.
mistimes a slap down to long-on
drilled down to long-off, hit too well as the fielder comes around
mistimes this slap to cover, once again a hint of a mix-up in the running. Fraser-McGurk is sent back
beaten by the skid off the pitch as he attempts to cut
tossed up googly outside off, driven into the gap at sweeper cover. They had to hare back for the second in the end
tucked away to fine leg
lines up for the pull but the ball is dug into the pitch, helps it along harmlessly past midwicket
slower one angled across, Pant taps it into the covers for a quick single
length ball on the stumps from wide of the crease, defended back
width on offer, punched into the gap at deep point. Nice and easily off the mark
slower length ball outside off, pulled to deep midwicket

that is an unbelievable catch at deep midwicket! Prithvi thinks he has nailed this slog sweep, he really has all told, but Pooran sprints in from the rope, committed fully to taking it, as he dives forward full stretch to take it nice and low. That ball was travelling and he did exceedingly well to make it look as simple as he did.
struck on the pad as he tries to hack him over cow corner
gets a stride forward and defends back to the bowler
pushed wide of cover as they scamper a quick single
looks to take him on with the pull but the ball skids through to hit him on the body before he could play the shot
off the inside edge into the pad again as he tries to punch through the covers
makes room to open up the off side, Krunal follows him and Prithvi nudges it into the gap at deep midwicket. Chances his luck with a second, struggled for much of it but made it in time.
struck on the pad as this one skids through with Prithvi trying to work it into the leg side
length ball and it disappears! Prithvi stays deep in the crease and slaps this over mid-on. Brute force
gets inside the line and sweeps him off his length to the deep backward square leg boundary. Lovely touch from Prithvi
looks to swing to the hills at deep midwicket, but gets an inside edge onto the pad as the ball rolls to the off side, they scamper a single
fired down leg, batter misses, Rahul can only flick a glove on it, races past short fine for five wides.
flatter one on middle and leg, nudged into the leg side for a quick single
carved over point! A frazzled Arshad gives him room, Fraser-McGurk sinks to his knees and opens the bat face to pick it up and over.
touch fuller on middle and leg, defends it into the leg side
massive, massive hit! Two scoring shots, two sixes.  Clears his front leg and wallops this wide of long-on for a 96-metre hit. He's got some power or what. Incredible
beaten as he tries to wallop another pull in front of square.

nearly commits hara-kiri in search of a single!  Worked this into the leg side and took off for a single without realising how quickly the bowler got to it on his followthrough. A direct hit at the bowler's and and Prithvi would've been walking back to the dug out.
glorious from Prithvi! Stand and deliver stuff. Thumped on the up back past the bowler and mid-off. So elegant, so beautiful, just looking like a....wow
punched straight to mid-off.
what a way to start his IPL career! Muscled for six. Picks the length early and disdainfully pulls him in front of square to clear midwicket effortlessly.
mistimes this full-length delivery to mid-on. Looked to throw his hands at that

bowled him! That's a strange way to go but Warner can't believe his luck. Dragged onto the stumps. Walks across to flick this over fine leg, but the ball lobs off the pad, hits the turf and rolls back onto the stumps. Warner stood there looking. He doesn't want to go but has to walk back. He was in some pain, didn't seem his usual self in the last few minutes.
steered to deep point, hares back for a risky second and makes it quite comfortably in the end
Warner shrieks in pain as he tries to slap this length ball through cover.
gets right behind the line as he dabs this short of length delivery to point
slapped down the ground for four! What a riposte. Over the umpire's head. Was looking to pick it over mid-on initially.
once again troubled by the extra bounce as Prithvi gets a thick inside edge onto the thigh pad as he tries to nudge it square on the leg side. Was a tad late on the shot
peach! Absolute peach. Prithvi is beaten fair and square by a nippy delivery that goes across the batter.
cramped for roomn as he plays a short-arm pull, down to deep square
taps it gently into the off side as they scamper a quick single. Stoinis from cover came charging in to flick an underarm throw at the striker's end, Rahul isn't pleased at giving a single like that

tries to manufacture something out of this and falls over! Warner was down on one knee while trying to get inside the line to lift it over square leg, missed it completely as the ball thudded into the body.
squirts one off an inside-edge to mid-on. Went for a big booming drive
closer to the stumps on a length, defended back

imperious! Shot of the evening for me. Prithvi fearlessly punches that one on the up through extra cover. Nice, high elbow as ball met bat, lovely followthrough and the pose for the cameras -  it gave him so much joy
no deep point and Prithvi creams this for four! Too much width, he simply reached out to slice this over the infield. Delightful timing and placement
goes full on off from wide of the crease, driven firmly to mid-off

lovely wrist work from Warner! Picks the length early and uses the depth of the crease to wrist this from outside off, picks the gap between midwicket and mid-on. The ball keeps gathering speed as it approaches the boundary cushion.
short of a length on middle and leg, tucked past square leg for a single. Prithvi's top hand came off the bat handle as he negotiated that one

forced wide of mid-off, no timing on that one. Once again, Arshad hits hard length and gets it to zip off the deck to hit the top part of Warner's bat. This is nerveless bowling from the youngster so far
this one cuts Warner into two halves!  Plays for the one that nips away but this hits the seam and decks back in to beat the inside edge. Plenty of fizz on the delivery too.
beaten as Warner nibbles at one shaping away from a fifth-stump line
lifter that raps Prithvi's gloves as he tries to tuck it off his hip, this one rolls to short fine and they jog a single. Good ball first up from Arshad.
